q: We define focal length, $f$ of a lens as the image distance when the object is at _____.
e: Focal length is defined as the image distance when the object is at infinity.

q: The object distance $u$ and the image distance $v$ are measured from the _____ of the lens $P$.
e: Object and image distances are measured from the centre of the lens P.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of real object, real image and real focus are _____.
e: Distances of real object, real image and real focus are positive.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, distances of virtual object, virtual image and virtual focus are _____.
e: Distances of virtual object, virtual image and virtual focus are negative.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured _____ the principal axis is positive.
e: Perpendicular distance measured above the principal axis is positive.

q: According to the sign convention for lenses, the perpendicular distance measured below the principal axis is _____.
e: Perpendicular distance measured below the principal axis is negative.

q: The lens-makers' equation relates the focal length to the refractive index and the radii of _____.
e: The lens-makers' equation uses the radii of curvature of the lens surfaces.
